implementation.name: Night Slashers (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 138 HDL source files (50 systemverilog, 75 verilog, 13 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 4 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 1 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 3 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-NightSlashers_MiSTer/blob/master/Template.sv carries the tag SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later (the repository has no LICENSE file, so the tag is the whole statement) -- read from the repository, not inferred. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 138 source files (50 systemverilog, 75 verilog, 13 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
